attachments.insertion_landmark: lateral coccyx and lowest sacral segment

actions: supports the posterior pelvic floor (with levator ani)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Small triangular muscle lying on the pelvic surface of the sacrospinous ligament, which it is frequently largely fused with/replaced by fibrous tissue in adults -- a well-documented degree of variable ossification/fibrosis unlike its more consistently muscular counterpart in most other mammals.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
